user.title: Passable Adaptive Smart Lighting
user.description: Choose what you would like to set up:

holiday_lighting.title: Holiday & Exterior Lighting Subsystem
holiday_lighting.description: Initialize the Holiday & Exterior Lighting Subsystem. Once added, you can manage dusk-to-dawn exterior lighting, active holidays, Philips Hue scenes, bulb effects, and decoration plugs from Configure.

room.title: Add Smart Lighting Room — Step 1: Hardware & Presence
room.description: Configure the primary light, occupancy sensors, and ambient lux sensor for this room. Optional tuning (secondary lamps, task floor, timeout scaling) is collapsed below.

data_description.room_name: Friendly name shown on dashboards and devices. An internal Room ID is automatically created from this name.
data_description.light_entity: Main overhead light or light group controlled automatically by this room.
data_description.presence_entity: One or more motion, mmWave, or occupancy sensors. Room is considered occupied if ANY selected sensor is active.
data_description.lux_sensor: Illuminance sensor (lx) used to harvest natural daylight and calibrate bulb yield.
data_description.target_lux: Baseline target illuminance while occupied. Over time, manual adjustments refine this by sun angle.
data_description.presence_timeout_min: Minutes with no detected presence before lights automatically turn off.

auxiliary_tuning.name: 🔧 Auxiliary Lights, Task Floor & Tuning (Optional)
auxiliary_tuning.description: Fine-tune secondary lamps, guest timeout scaling, and initial brightness calibration.

data.room_id: Custom Room ID (Optional — auto-generated if blank)
data.suppress_main_when_secondary_on: Turn Off Primary Light When a Secondary Light is ON

data_description.room_id: Leave blank to auto-generate (e.g. 'living_room'). Only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores are used.
data_description.secondary_lights: Optional floor/table lamps. Swept off on vacancy (outside freeze) and excluded from main bulb yield learning.
data_description.suppress_main_when_secondary_on: When enabled, turning on any secondary lamp turns off the main overhead light for cozy lamp-only lighting.
data_description.timeout_scale_entities: Optional entities (e.g. Guest Mode switch) that multiply the vacancy timeout when ON or ACTIVE.
data_description.timeout_scale_factor: Multiplier applied to Vacancy Timeout whenever any selected scaling entity is active (e.g. 3.0x).
data_description.min_occupied_pct: Minimum brightness floor while occupied, even during bright daylight (useful for kitchens or offices). Set 0 to allow full daylight shutoff.
data_description.default_lux_ratio: Estimated room lux added per 1% brightness before the engine finishes learning your room curve.

room_features.title: Add Smart Lighting Room — Step 2: Optional Features
room_features.description:
Enable optional features for **{room_name}**. Only the features you enable here will show follow-up settings.

**Mode Priority (Highest → Lowest):** Manual Override → Force-Off / Freeze → Visual Notification → Media Playback → Late Night → Occupied Ambient Lux.

data_description.circadian_enabled: Smoothly shifts color temperature throughout the day based on sun elevation.
data_description.min_color_temp: Applied at night and around sunrise/sunset when Circadian Rhythm is enabled.
data_description.max_color_temp: Applied near solar noon when Circadian Rhythm is enabled.
data_description.late_night_enabled: Overrides daytime lux targeting with a dim nighttime brightness preset.
data_description.late_night_condition_type: Choose how Late Night starts & stops: fixed clock times, dynamic input_datetime helpers, or an entity/home state.
data_description.media_entities: If selected, lights dim to a movie/TV preset whenever any chosen media player is playing or paused.
data_description.configure_bypasses: Enable to customize override timeout, native override/freeze switches, force-off helpers, or slow lux sensor cooldown.
data_description.notification_light_enabled: Claim a single bulb to display a colored alert (e.g. laundry ready) while other lights work normally.

room_late_night.title: Late Night Mode — {mode_label}
room_late_night.description: Configure target brightness and the trigger inputs for **{mode_label}**.

data_description.late_night_pct: Target brightness when Late Night Mode is active and room is occupied.
data_description.late_night_learn_prefs: When enabled, manual dimming during Late Night is remembered and averaged over time. Disable to keep brightness locked to the seed %.
data_description.late_night_start_time: Daily clock time when Late Night begins (supports overnight windows such as 22:00 to 06:00).
data_description.late_night_stop_time: Daily clock time when Late Night ends and normal daytime lux targeting resumes.
data_description.late_night_start_entity: input_datetime helper defining when Late Night begins. Listeners update automatically if you change the helper time.
data_description.late_night_stop_entity: input_datetime helper defining when Late Night ends.
data_description.late_night_entity: Entity or group whose state activates Late Night (e.g. input_boolean.bedtime, binary_sensor, schedule, or input_select.home_state).
data_description.late_night_entity_states: Leave blank to match standard active states (on, true, home, active, sleep, bedtime, pre-sleep), or enter exact states like 'sleep, pre-sleep'.

room_media.title: Media Player Dimming Settings
room_media.description: Configure how lights behave when one of your selected media players is active.

data.media_respect_ambient_lux: Respect Natural Daylight (Keep / Turn Off in Daylight)

data_description.media_seed_pct: Target brightness when media is playing (set 0% to turn lights off while watching).
data_description.media_respect_ambient_lux: When enabled, media lighting stays off if natural daylight already meets your room's Target Lux.
data_description.media_learn_prefs: When enabled, manual dimming during media playback is learned over time. Disable to lock to the seed %.

room_bypasses.title: Overrides, Bypasses & Sensor Safeguards
room_bypasses.description: Manual wall-switch or app changes are **always detected automatically**—optional switches and helpers below let you view or trigger locks from dashboards and automations.

override_behavior.name: 🔒 Manual Override Behavior
override_behavior.description: Control how long automatic lighting pauses after a manual adjustment.

data.ignore_max_brightness_override: Treat Turning On to 100% from Off as Normal On

data_description.override_timeout_min: Minutes to pause automatic dimming after a manual wall-switch or app change (cleared early if the room becomes vacant).
data_description.ignore_max_brightness_override: When enabled, flipping a wall switch to 100% from off lets the engine settle to adaptive brightness instead of locking manual override.
data_description.create_override_switch: Creates a dedicated switch.<room>_manual_override entity in Home Assistant to view or toggle the override lock.
data_description.manual_override_entity: Optional existing input_boolean or switch synced two-way with the room's override state.

bypass_entities.name: 🛑 Freeze & Force-Off Bypasses
bypass_entities.description: Pause automation temporarily or force lights off during Away / Sleep modes.

data.create_freeze_switch: Create Built-In Freeze Bypass Switch Entity

data_description.create_freeze_switch: Creates a dedicated switch.<room>_freeze_bypass entity to hold lights in their current state without turning them off.
data_description.bypass_freeze_entities: Entities that pause all automation and hold lights as-is while ON/active (e.g. sleeping_in_living_room).
data_description.bypass_off_entities: Entities that pause automation and turn all room lights OFF while ON/active (e.g. Away Mode).

hardware_safeguards.name: ⚡ Sensor Cooldown & Power Outage Guard
hardware_safeguards.description: Prevent oscillation with slow lux sensors and false overrides after power restoration.

data_description.settling_cooldown_sec: Wait time between closed-loop lux trims so slow Zigbee/Matter sensors can report updated readings.
data_description.power_grid_entity: Optional sensor/binary_sensor indicating grid power; halts evaluation while offline so power-restoration spikes do not lock overrides.

room_notification.title: Visual Notification Light Settings
room_notification.description: Claim an individual bulb out of the room to display a visual color alert while the remaining room lights continue adaptive dimming.

data.notification_presence_gated: Presence-Gated (Show Only When Room Is Occupied)

data_description.notification_trigger_entity: Entity (e.g. input_boolean.laundry_washer_pending) that activates the alert when ON or active.
data_description.notification_light_entity: Specific bulb or fixture to claim for notifications (if part of the room light group, other bulbs keep working normally).
data_description.notification_color: RGB color displayed while the notification is active.
data_description.notification_brightness_pct: Brightness percentage for the alert bulb.
data_description.notification_presence_gated: When enabled, the alert only illuminates while the room is occupied and turns off on vacancy.
data_description.notification_suppression_entities: Entities (e.g. home_state or sleep boolean) that suppress the alert during sleep or quiet hours.

data_description.simulation_enabled: Master toggle enabling away-mode lighting simulation.
data_description.simulation_label: All Home Assistant light entities carrying this label are automatically included.
data_description.simulation_mode: Hybrid replays your real occupied history and falls back to synthetic evening routines if history is unavailable.

presence_simulation_tuning.title: Presence Simulation — Step 2: Timing & Brightness
presence_simulation_tuning.description:
Fine-tune timing and brightness for the selected simulation strategy.

{lights_summary}

data_description.simulation_lookback_days: Number of past days searched in Home Assistant Recorder for genuine occupied lighting history.
data_description.simulation_jitter_min: Random +/- minute offset applied to scheduled transitions so lights don't switch at the exact same minute daily.
data_description.simulation_arrival_grace_min: Vacancy countdown applied to already-lit rooms when you arrive home after dark.
data_description.simulation_max_brightness_pct: Upper brightness cap applied to simulated lights.

error.invalid_room_id: Please enter a valid Room Name containing letters or numbers.
error.missing_late_night_entity: Please select a Trigger Entity / Group for Entity State mode.
error.missing_datetime_helper: Please select both Start and Stop input_datetime helpers.
error.missing_schedule_time: Please provide both Start and Stop clock times.
error.missing_notification_trigger: Please select a Notification Trigger Entity.
error.missing_notification_light: Please select a Target Notification Bulb.

abort.already_configured: This room ID is already configured in Passable Smart Light Engine.

room_opt_hardware.title: Hardware, Presence & Target Lux
room_opt_hardware.description: Update the room's friendly name, lights, sensors, and occupancy/lux targets.

data_description.room_name: Friendly display name used in the UI and device title (existing entity IDs are preserved).
data_description.light_entity: Main overhead light or light group controlled automatically by this room.
data_description.presence_entity: Room is considered occupied if ANY selected sensor is active.
data_description.lux_sensor: Illuminance sensor (lx) used to measure ambient light.
data_description.presence_timeout_min: Minutes of vacancy before lights turn off automatically.

auxiliary_tuning.name: 🔧 Auxiliary Lights, Task Floor & Tuning
auxiliary_tuning.description: Optional secondary lamps, guest timeout scaling, task floor, and initial lux yield.

data.suppress_main_when_secondary_on: Turn Off Primary Light When a Secondary Light is ON

data_description.secondary_lights: Optional lamps swept off on vacancy and excluded from main bulb yield learning.
data_description.suppress_main_when_secondary_on: Automatically turns off the main overhead light whenever a secondary lamp is turned on.
data_description.timeout_scale_entities: Optional entities (e.g. Guest Mode) that multiply Vacancy Timeout when active.
data_description.timeout_scale_factor: Multiplier applied when any scaling entity is active (e.g. 3.0x).
data_description.min_occupied_pct: Minimum brightness floor while occupied (0 allows full daylight shutoff).
data_description.default_lux_ratio: Fallback lux per 1% brightness before room curve calibration completes.

data_description.circadian_enabled: Shifts color temperature smoothly throughout the day based on sun elevation.
data_description.min_color_temp: Warmest Kelvin target used at night and twilight.
data_description.max_color_temp: Coolest Kelvin target used at solar noon.

room_opt_late_night.title: Late Night Mode — Step 1: Mode & Brightness
room_opt_late_night.description: Enable Late Night Mode and choose how it triggers. Next, you will only see the fields required for your chosen trigger mode.

data_description.late_night_enabled: When disabled, Late Night Mode never activates.
data_description.late_night_pct: Target brightness during Late Night when occupied.
data_description.late_night_learn_prefs: When enabled, manual brightness changes during Late Night are averaged into your preset. Disable to keep brightness fixed.
data_description.late_night_condition_type: Fixed Clock Schedule uses daily times; Dynamic Time Helpers reads input_datetime entities; Entity / Home State watches a switch, sensor, group, or input_select.

data_description.late_night_start_time: Daily clock time when Late Night starts (supports overnight schedules like 22:00 to 06:00).
data_description.late_night_stop_time: Daily clock time when Late Night stops.
data_description.late_night_start_entity: input_datetime helper defining when Late Night starts.
data_description.late_night_stop_entity: input_datetime helper defining when Late Night stops.
data_description.late_night_entity: Entity or group whose state activates Late Night (e.g. input_boolean.bedtime, binary_sensor, schedule, or input_select.home_state).
data_description.late_night_entity_states: Leave blank to match default active states (on, true, home, active, sleep, bedtime, pre-sleep), or enter comma-separated states.

room_opt_media.title: Media Player Dimming
room_opt_media.description: Dim room lights automatically whenever selected media players are playing or paused.

data.media_respect_ambient_lux: Respect Natural Daylight (Keep / Turn Off in Daylight)

data_description.media_entities: Leave empty to disable media dimming for this room.
data_description.media_seed_pct: Target brightness while media is active (0% turns lights off).
data_description.media_respect_ambient_lux: Keep lights off during media playback if natural daylight already meets your room's Target Lux.
data_description.media_learn_prefs: Remember manual brightness adjustments made during media playback.

room_opt_bypasses.title: Overrides, Bypasses & Sensor Safeguards
room_opt_bypasses.description: Manual wall-switch or app changes are **always detected automatically**—optional switches and helpers below let you inspect or control overrides and freezes from dashboards or automations.

override_behavior.name: 🔒 Manual Override Behavior
override_behavior.description: Control lockout timing and optional dashboard override switches.

data.ignore_max_brightness_override: Treat Turning On to 100% from Off as Normal On

data_description.override_timeout_min: Minutes to keep manual override active before resuming adaptive control.
data_description.ignore_max_brightness_override: When enabled, turning a light on from off to 100% lets adaptive lighting run instead of locking override.
data_description.create_override_switch: Creates switch.<room>_manual_override to monitor or clear override from dashboards.
data_description.manual_override_entity: Optional existing input_boolean or switch synced two-way with override state.

bypass_entities.name: 🛑 Freeze & Force-Off Bypasses
bypass_entities.description: Configure entities that hold lights as-is or force lights off.

data.create_freeze_switch: Create Built-In Freeze Bypass Switch Entity

data_description.create_freeze_switch: Creates switch.<room>_freeze_bypass to pause automation and hold current brightness.
data_description.bypass_freeze_entities: Entities that pause automation and keep lights at their current state when ON/active.
data_description.bypass_off_entities: Entities that pause automation and force all room lights OFF when ON/active.

hardware_safeguards.name: ⚡ Sensor Cooldown & Power Outage Guard
hardware_safeguards.description: Configure slow lux sensor settling and power grid outage protection.

data_description.settling_cooldown_sec: Wait time between closed-loop trims for slow Zigbee/Matter illuminance sensors.
data_description.power_grid_entity: Optional sensor/binary_sensor that halts automation while grid power is offline.

room_opt_notification.title: Visual Notification Light — Step 1
room_opt_notification.description:
Claim an individual bulb to display visual color alerts while other room lights operate normally.

{notif_summary}

data_description.notification_light_enabled: Enable to configure the alert trigger, target bulb, color, and suppression rules.

room_opt_notification_details.title: Visual Notification Light — Step 2: Alert Details
room_opt_notification_details.description: Select the trigger entity, target bulb, alert color, and quiet-hours suppression.

data.notification_presence_gated: Presence-Gated (Show Only When Room Is Occupied)

data_description.notification_trigger_entity: Entity that triggers the visual alert when ON or active.
data_description.notification_light_entity: Individual light fixture or bulb claimed for notifications.
data_description.notification_color: RGB color displayed while the alert is active.
data_description.notification_brightness_pct: Brightness percentage for the alert bulb.
data_description.notification_presence_gated: Only illuminate the alert bulb while the room is occupied.
data_description.notification_suppression_entities: Entities that suppress the alert when active (e.g. sleep mode or home_state).

system_menu.title: Passable Smart Light Engine — System Settings
system_menu.description: Choose a system subsystem to configure:

presence_simulation_options.title: Presence Simulation — Step 1: Target & Strategy
presence_simulation_options.description:
Configure house-wide presence simulation enablement, target label, and strategy.

{lights_summary}

data_description.simulation_enabled: Disable to turn off away-mode presence simulation completely.
data_description.simulation_label: Light entities carrying this Home Assistant label are automatically included.
data_description.simulation_mode: Hybrid replays real history and falls back to synthetic evening routines when history is missing.

presence_simulation_options_tuning.title: Presence Simulation — Step 2: Timing & Brightness
presence_simulation_options_tuning.description:
Adjust timing and brightness for the selected simulation strategy.

{lights_summary}

data_description.simulation_lookback_days: Past days searched in Home Assistant Recorder for occupied lighting history.
data_description.simulation_jitter_min: Randomized +/- minute offset applied to scheduled light transitions.
data_description.simulation_arrival_grace_min: Vacancy countdown applied to simulated lights when arriving home after dark.
data_description.simulation_max_brightness_pct: Maximum brightness percentage allowed during simulation.

holiday_menu.title: Holiday & Exterior Lighting Configuration
holiday_menu.description: Manage dusk-to-dawn exterior lighting, scheduled holidays, lighting scenes, and outdoor decoration plugs.

holiday_exterior_settings.title: Exterior Dusk-to-Dawn — Step 1: Lights & Triggers
holiday_exterior_settings.description: Configure year-round exterior lighting and choose how it turns on/off. Next, you will only see timing fields for the triggers you chose.

data_description.exterior_dusk_to_dawn_enabled: Automatically runs exterior baseline warm white (or active holiday effects) overnight.
data_description.exterior_lights: Exterior lights controlled nightly from dusk to dawn.
data_description.exterior_baseline_kelvin: Warm white Kelvin used on non-holiday nights (and after sleep if Revert is chosen).
data_description.exterior_baseline_brightness_pct: Brightness percentage for non-holiday baseline nights.
data_description.exterior_on_trigger: Choose sunset with offset or a fixed clock time.
data_description.exterior_off_trigger: Choose sunrise with offset or a fixed clock time.
data_description.holiday_late_night_behavior: Choose whether holiday colors run all night or revert to warm white when Home State enters Sleep.

holiday_exterior_schedule.title: Exterior Dusk-to-Dawn — Step 2: Schedule Details
holiday_exterior_schedule.description: Set the exact offsets, fixed times, or Home State entity for your selected triggers.

data.exterior_sunset_offset_min: Sunset Offset (Minutes, e.g. -30 for 30m before sunset)
data.exterior_sunrise_offset_min: Sunrise Offset (Minutes, e.g. +30 for 30m after sunrise)

data_description.exterior_sunset_offset_min: Negative values turn lights on before sunset; positive values turn them on after sunset.
data_description.exterior_on_time: Fixed daily clock time to turn exterior lights on.
data_description.exterior_sunrise_offset_min: Positive values keep lights on past sunrise; negative values turn them off early.
data_description.exterior_off_time: Fixed daily clock time to turn exterior lights off.
data_description.holiday_home_state_entity: Entity whose state enters 'sleep' at bedtime so holiday lights revert to baseline warm white.

holiday_decoration_settings.title: Outdoor Holiday Decorations — Step 1: Plugs & Triggers
holiday_decoration_settings.description: Configure outdoor holiday smart plugs and choose their on/off triggers.

data.holiday_respect_presence_simulation: Respect Presence Simulation (Don't override away mode)

data_description.holiday_decorations_enabled: Automatically switches holiday smart plugs during active holiday date ranges.
data_description.holiday_global_decorations: Smart plugs/switches controlled during active holidays.
data_description.holiday_global_label: Any switch entity carrying this Home Assistant label is also included automatically.
data_description.decorations_on_trigger: Choose sunset with offset or a fixed clock time.
data_description.decorations_off_trigger: Choose Sleep state, Sunrise, or a fixed cutoff time.
data_description.holiday_respect_presence_simulation: Avoids overriding lights currently managed by Away Mode presence simulation.

holiday_decoration_schedule.title: Outdoor Holiday Decorations — Step 2: Schedule Details
holiday_decoration_schedule.description: Set the exact offsets, fixed times, or Home State entity for your decoration plugs.

data_description.decorations_sunset_offset_min: Negative values turn plugs on before sunset; positive values after sunset.
data_description.decorations_on_time: Fixed daily clock time to turn decoration plugs on.
data_description.decorations_off_time: Fixed daily cutoff time to turn decoration plugs off.
data_description.holiday_home_state_entity: Entity whose state becomes 'sleep' at bedtime to shut off outdoor decorations.

holiday_select.title: Select Holiday to Edit
holiday_select.description: Choose an existing holiday to edit its schedule, mode, and lights, or select 'Add New Holiday'.

holiday_edit.title: Edit Holiday — Step 1: Dates, Targets & Mode
holiday_edit.description: Configure dates, display metadata, participating fixtures, and lighting mode. Next, you will only see fields for the lighting mode you choose.

data.name: Holiday Name
data.participating_lights: Custom Participating Lights (Leave empty for global default)
data.participating_decorations: Custom Decoration Plugs (Leave empty for global default)

data.fallback_effect: Fallback Bulb Effect (Optional, if primary unavailable)
data.rgb_color: RGB Color (or Fallback for Non-Effect/Non-Hue Bulbs)

data_description.hue_scene: Select the Home Assistant scene entity for this holiday.
data_description.dynamic_scene: Enables dynamic animation when activating Philips Hue scenes.
data_description.effect: Firmware effect sent to supporting lights (e.g. fire, candle, prism).
data_description.fallback_effect: Used if a fixture cannot activate the primary Hue scene or effect.
data_description.rgb_color: Color applied directly in RGB mode, or as a fallback if a bulb lacks scenes/effects.
data_description.color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature applied in Kelvin mode.
data_description.brightness_pct: Target brightness percentage for the holiday.

holiday_reset.title: Reset Holiday Catalog
holiday_reset.description: Are you sure you want to restore the built-in holiday catalog? This will revert any custom dates, effects, or added holidays to their default settings.

error.invalid_date: Invalid date format. Please use MM-DD (e.g., 10-01).
error.missing_late_night_entity: Please select a Trigger Entity / Group for Entity State mode.
error.missing_datetime_helper: Please select both Start and Stop input_datetime helpers.
error.missing_schedule_time: Please provide both Start and Stop clock times.
error.missing_notification_trigger: Please select a Notification Trigger Entity.
error.missing_notification_light: Please select a Target Notification Bulb.
error.missing_hue_scene: Please select a Philips Hue Scene entity.
error.missing_bulb_effect: Please select or enter a Bulb Firmware Effect.

start_presence_simulation.name: Start Presence Simulation
start_presence_simulation.description: Activates presence simulation across all lights tagged with the configured label (default 'lights_presence_simulation').

stop_presence_simulation.name: Stop Presence Simulation
stop_presence_simulation.description: Deactivates presence simulation. If stopping at night with Home mode active, performs graceful handover to room controllers; otherwise sweeps off all simulated lights.

apply_holiday_lighting.name: Apply Holiday Lighting
apply_holiday_lighting.description: Manually triggers or re-evaluates holiday lighting according to the active holiday schedule.

preview_holiday.name: Preview Holiday
preview_holiday.description: Previews a holiday lighting scene and effects across configured lights for a short test period.

clear_manual_override.name: Clear Manual Override
clear_manual_override.description: Clears an active manual override lockout for a specific room or all rooms and smoothly resumes adaptive lighting evaluation.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Optional room ID to clear (e.g. 'kitchen'). Omit or pass 'all' to clear manual overrides across all rooms.

clear_notification.name: Clear Visual Notification
clear_notification.description: Clears an active or pending visual notification light for a specific room or all rooms, turns off boolean/switch notification triggers, and restores adaptive room lighting.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Optional room ID to clear (e.g. 'living_room'). Omit or pass 'all' to clear visual notifications across all rooms.
